name: The Sanctity Of Life
overview: Scripture reveals the sanctity of life by affirming that humanity is uniquely created in the image of God, as seen in Genesis 1:27 and reaffirmed in Genesis 9:6, which underscores the sacredness of human life by condemning the shedding of man's blood. Life is portrayed as a divine gift, with God holding the soul and breath of every living person (Job 12:10), and the intimate creation of life in the womb is acknowledged in Job 31:15. Furthermore, children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), emphasizing the preciousness and divine value of every human life. The commandment in Exodus 20:13, 'Thou shalt not kill,' reinforces the moral imperative to protect life as sacred and inviolable.
